name: Megami to Love! ~5nin no Megami-sama to Ichahame Haramase Shinkon Seikatsu♪~
original_name: 女神とLOVE！～5人の女神様とイチャハメ孕ませ新婚生活♪～
source:
One day you spied upon five goddesses bathing. However, rules dictate that any human who learns the lineage of a goddess must either be erased from existence, or make a lovechild with her.

Since you saw all five women... it's time to start making babies like no tomorrow!! 

[From [url=http://eng.dlsite.com/work/=/product_id/RE067113.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
有一天，你发现五位女神正在洗澡。然而，规则规定，任何得知女神血统的人类必须要么从存在中抹去，要么与她生下私生子。

既然你看到了所有五个女人……是时候开始像没有明天一样生孩子了！
